hero.h1: Commercial Water Heaters in Mokena, IL
hero.sub: A restaurant on LaGrange Road, a salon in a strip center or a shop near Front Street. When the water heater fails, business slows down. We repair, replace and maintain commercial water heaters for Mokena businesses. From our office on Jodi Road.

blocks.intro: Some of the businesses we keep running:

tiles.body: Three-compartment sinks and dishwashers can drain a small tank before the lunch rush is over.
Back-to-back appointments and locker room showers mean steady demand all day.
Handwashing sinks in every room, and inspectors who check them.
Plenty of hot water at safe, controlled temperatures.

blocks.intro: We stay with your equipment from the first install to the last repair:

steps.body: Gas and electric commercial tanks, storage tanks and tankless banks, diagnosed before we quote.
A new unit sized to your peak demand, swapped in at a time that doesn't shut you down.
Flushing, descaling, anode and relief valve checks on a calendar you choose.

img.alt: Dishwasher rinsing a pan under a pre-rinse sprayer at a stainless steel sink in a busy restaurant kitchen

blocks.intro: Our office on Jodi Road is close to Mokena's main business corridors.

items.body: In strip centers along the main roads, one utility room may serve several businesses. We coordinate access with the property owner and the shops next door.
If the heater quits mid-shift, call any time. Our line is open 24/7.
Every repair and replacement is priced before work starts.
Many commercial spaces in Mokena were built in the 1990s and 2000s. The water heaters installed then are past their expected life.

blocks.h2: What Affects the Price of Commercial Water Heater Work
blocks.body: Capacity, fuel and venting matter most. Newer commercial spaces are often easier to work in, but code updates and access still affect the scope. We look at your setup and quote one flat price.

blocks.rating: 4.7 stars from 5,669+ Google reviews across all J. Blanton locations.

reviews.text: Ron is professionial, courteous and knowledgable. I asked for a verification that shower drain installed 8 years ago was up to code. Ron not only made pictures and gave his diagnosis, he took it a step farther and made a video. Awseome service.

blocks.h2: Commercial Water Heater Questions From Mokena Businesses

items.q: Will you work before we open or after we close?
items.preview: For planned jobs, yes, when we can.
items.answer: For a planned replacement or a maintenance visit, we'll schedule around your hours whenever possible. A failure is different: call us any time.

items.q: What if our heater dies on a Saturday?
items.preview: Call us. Our line is open 24/7.
items.answer: Call us. Our phone line is open around the clock, weekends included.

items.q: Our tank keeps running out at peak times. Is it too small?
items.answer: Possibly. We look at your busiest hour, the fixtures and equipment you run and the temperature you need, then tell you whether a larger tank, a second unit or tankless makes sense.
Yes. We can keep a maintenance calendar and service records for each location.

items.q: Do you service businesses along LaGrange Road?
items.answer: Yes. We serve restaurants, shops and offices across Mokena.

items.q: What does a commercial water heater cost to replace in Mokena?
items.preview: It varies with size, fuel and venting. You'll get a flat price first.
items.answer: It varies with the size, the fuel, the venting and any code changes the new unit needs. You'll get a flat-rate price before any work.
